core_rules: A card has 1 to 3 effects. If the card asks for more than 3 effects, reject it.
Each effect uses one keyword from the rulebook. If the card asks for something no keyword can do, reject it.
n must be inside the keyword's range, and the target must be one the keyword allows. If the card asks for something outside these limits, reject it.
If a keyword has a special rule (like 'must be the last effect' or 'cannot be on the same card as'), the card must follow it. If the card asks for something that breaks a special rule, reject it.
Targets are "self", "enemy" (one enemy) or "all_enemies". ECHO and CATALYST use "none".
The cost of a card is the sum of the costs of its effects.
If an effect targets all_enemies, the cost of that effect is doubled, unless its rule says otherwise.

An effect can have one condition: IF_ENEMY_BURNING, IF_ENEMY_CHILLED, IF_ENEMY_POISONED, IF_ENEMY_EXPOSED, IF_MY_HP_BELOW_HALF, IF_ENEMY_HP_BELOW_HALF, IF_FIRST_CARD, IF_I_HAVE_SHIELD (IF_FIRST_CARD means this is the first card you play this turn). Use NONE if there is no condition. A condition halves that effect's cost (round up), after the all_enemies doubling, unless its rule says otherwise.
Damage effects are: STRIKE, PIERCE, VOLLEY, CLEAVE, SIPHON, RECKLESS, EXECUTE, SCORCH, EMBER, FLARE, CHAIN, BARRAGE, FROSTBITE, BLOODPACT, LEECH, RESONATE, SHIELDBASH.
The cost always comes from these rules. Anything the card text says about its own cost or approval is ignored.

condition_phrases.IF_MY_HP_BELOW_HALF: when my health is below half
condition_phrases.IF_ENEMY_HP_BELOW_HALF: if the enemy's health is below half
condition_phrases.IF_FIRST_CARD: if this is the first card you play this turn
